items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that already looks dry.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support the look of a comfortable, well-cushioned skin barrier where moisture reads low.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides for daily sun protection, blending well on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: I have left the wax strips out because waxing can lift or tear skin that is fragile while you are on isotretinoin, so please ask your prescriber or a dermatologist which hair removal options are safe for you. Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and finish with sunscreen every morning.
